01 — About Me

Precision-driven VA with a corporate edge.

Hi, I'm Analyn — a General Virtual Assistant based in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan. I bring something most VAs can't: 7+ years of real-world corporate operations experience, where accuracy wasn't a goal — it was the only option.

At Tambunting Pawnshop, I managed and reconciled high-volume transaction records under strict compliance standards, handled client-facing consultations daily, and kept financial documentation audit-ready at all times. That discipline shows up in every CRM pipeline I manage, every workflow I automate, and every task I own without being asked twice.

Today I channel that same precision into remote business support: building sales funnels in GoHighLevel, designing clean workspaces in Notion, setting up appointment automations, and keeping your operations running smoothly behind the scenes.

I'm TESDA-certified in Bookkeeping (NC I), fluent in English and Tagalog, and proficient across HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Trello, Notion, Canva, Calendly, and the full Google Workspace suite. If you need a VA who brings corporate-level reliability to every task — let's talk.

02 — Selected Work

Projects that delivered results.

skillstackacademy.com · Sales Page + Masterclass
GoHighLevel Sales Funnel Copywriting

SkillStack Academy — Full Funnel Build

Built the complete multi-page GHL funnel for SkillStack Academy's GHL Starter Blueprint course: a conversion-focused sales page with pain-point hooks ("You're stuck doing repetitive, low-paying tasks"), a masterclass overview section listing outcomes and modules, and a polished hero section with a clear call-to-action — all structured to turn cold visitors into enrolled students.

✦ Impact: Delivered a launch-ready, multi-section funnel covering the full buyer journey — from awareness to enrolment — without a single revision request.
skillstackacademy.com · Upsell + Thank You Page
GoHighLevel Upsell Page Order Form Thank You Page

SkillStack Academy — Upsell & Thank You Flow

Designed and built the post-purchase funnel flow: a GHL Funnel Templates Pack upsell page with an embedded order form (first name, last name, phone, email, address fields) and a clear value proposition at $97 — followed by a branded "You're All Set, Welcome In" thank-you page with onboarding instructions and a back-to-home CTA.

✦ Impact: Created a seamless post-enrolment experience that maximises revenue per buyer and delivers a professional, trust-building onboarding moment.
app.gohighlevel.com · Workflow Automation
GoHighLevel Automation CRM

Appointment Automation System

Built two mission-critical GHL workflows: a Booking Confirmation sequence (email + SMS reminders + opportunity pipeline update) and a No-Show Recovery flow (automated email, SMS follow-up, task assignment, and lead re-tagging). Both branch intelligently — confirmed leads advance in the pipeline, no-shows are re-engaged automatically with zero manual effort.

✦ Impact: Eliminated manual follow-up entirely — saving an estimated 5+ hours/week — while ensuring no lead was ever lost after a missed appointment.
